title: 🔍 Microsoft rebuilds Windows 11 search from scratch — faster, lighter and ad-free!
body: 🔍 Microsoft rebuilds Windows 11 search from scratch — faster, lighter and ad-free!
Microsoft released the optional KB5132057 update for Windows 11 versions 25H2 and 26H2 on November 20, containing 28 changes and fixes, the most prominent being a complete rebuild of search.

The new search is built on WinUI 3 technology instead of the previous web technology, making it faster and using less memory, with results in a single list and no promotional content in web results. Web and Store results can also be disabled from the settings.
Search adds "inline actions" directly from the search box: turning on dark mode or Bluetooth, adjusting brightness, muting sound, and connecting to an Android phone via Phone Link.
A new Run window also arrives with a modern design, appearing in just 94 milliseconds, enabled from the settings, and File Explorer search from "This PC" now relies on the index, making it faster.
The update improves face recognition in Windows Hello, temporarily raising screen brightness in dark rooms, and raises devices to build 26300.10075 for version 26H2 or 26200.10075 for version 25H2.

The update is optional and non-security, and its changes will reach everyone in the December update, the last non-security preview update in 2026. The device may need one extra restart to update the Secure Boot certificate.

Simply put: imagine Windows search becoming like a fast, clean search: you type, results appear instantly without ads, and you turn on dark mode or Bluetooth from the same place without opening the settings.
What bothers you most about the current Windows search: the slowness or the ads?
